title: Nexbyte Hub Come Share Your Script

Welcome to Nexbyte Hub!

A modern, fast, and constantly updated script loader designed to give you the best experience across multiple games.

✨ Features

Multi-Game Support: Automatically syncs and fetches the latest game scripts

Universal Script: Works on unsupported games with essential utility tools.

Dynamic Island & Clean UI: Sleek layout powered by WindUI.

Search Bar: Quickly find scripts for your favorite games.

Auto-Load System: Saves your game preferences for quick injection.

📜 How to Use

1. Execute the loadstring in your preferred executor.

2. Select your current game from the sidebar (or use Universal Tools).

3. Click "Inject Script" and enjoy!

💬 Community & Support

Join our Discord server for new game updates, script requests, and community support!
